name: figmake-pro
description: Design-to-code compiler with AI agent guardrails. Extract Figma designs as pixel-perfect React code with enforced design tokens.

scripts.build: npm run build:plugin && npm run build:cli
scripts.build:plugin: esbuild src/plugin/code.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/plugin/code.js && cp src/plugin/ui.html dist/plugin/ui.html && cp src/plugin/manifest.json dist/plugin/manifest.json
